fields.why: Coverage across four insurance groups is tested against the privately insured referent (Table 2), and race and MSA comparisons are reported in text.
Insurance (SES), race/ethnicity (Black, Hispanic vs White) and MSA status (three levels); poverty status is two groups and adds no entry.
Two-proportion t-tests with significance marked against the referent group; race and MSA contrasts are likewise referent-based, though their tables are supplementary and not in the packet.
